headline: Alpha Turbo Boss
title: Alpha Turbo | Use Nimbi to Ground It | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Alpha Turbo is a Wind boss, so bring Electric or Light Aniimo and avoid Wind. The trick is its flying phase. When it lifts off it is protected, so do not waste skills on it. Instead, lure it into the Nimbi. They stick to its wool, and once two are attached it gets overloaded and crashes down. That is your window to deal Break damage. Have you beaten Turbo yet? Comment below!

scenes.sub: It is protected, hold your skills

description: Alpha Turbo boss tips in Aniimo: it is a Wind boss weak to Electric and Light. When it flies it is protected, so lure it into two Nimbi, which stick to its wool and make it crash down, then use the grounded window for Break damage.
